position_in_sequence: Phase 0 feasibility prerequisite for SPPPO. This is NOT EXP2D and NOT a latent-architecture variant; the latent ladder is closed.
purpose: determine whether a trustworthy action-conditioned strategic scorer can exist at all. If it cannot, SPPPO is not built.

why_the_scorer_must_be_ACTION_conditione.reason: its output does not depend on the student's actions, so a ranking loss built from it has NO gradient into the actor. It could be perfectly satisfied while teaching the policy nothing about which action to change -- a scoreboard, not a teacher.
why_the_scorer_must_be_ACTION_conditione.required_form: Q_psi(o, a_1:2, pole) -- centralised over the joint action
why_the_scorer_must_be_ACTION_conditione.derived_quantity: V_hat_psi(o, z, p) = E_{a ~ pi_theta(.|o,z)} [ Q_psi(o, a, p) ]
ranking_condition_it_enables: V_hat(o, z0, A) > V_hat(o, z1, A)
V_hat(o, z1, B) > V_hat(o, z0, B)

NO_EVALUATION_LEAKAGE.rule: no scored evaluation block may be used to fit Q_psi
NO_EVALUATION_LEAKAGE.their_role: external ground-truth reference ONLY. They must not be used to tune thresholds, select scorer architecture, or choose features. The scorer stands or falls before they are consulted.

why_rejected: EPISODE-level only: one row per episode, no per-state observations, so (o, a) pairs do not exist

NO CROSS-POLE CELLS: pi_A trained only vs SCRIPTED:OP6 (2144 rows), pi_B only vs SCRIPTED:OP7 (2088 rows). The gate needs pi_B's behaviour on pole A, which was never trained and exists only in evaluation blocks.
source_1_rejected.note: this is a structural absence, not a volume shortfall

data_source_decision.source_2_adopted: a fresh, prospectively reserved TRAINING-ONLY scorer block, disjoint from every development and evaluation block

per_decision_point_records: policy identity (PROVENANCE ONLY -- never a scorer input)
collection.decision_points_only: inherit the SAPPO lesson: train on macro-decision points (blue_commit_ticks_left <= 0), not locked physics steps. The ranking objective concerns moments where commitment can change.
collection.policy_identity_must_not_be_a_feature: otherwise the scorer can cheat by learning 'pi_A usually wins on A' instead of which decisions are payoff-relevant. It must learn (o, a, pole) -> future strategic value.

GATE_0A_cell_level_replication.question: does the fresh training-only sample contain the strategic signal we intend to learn?
GATE_0A_cell_level_replication.status: NOT the scorer validation. A sanity check on the dataset.
GATE_0A_cell_level_replication.if_fails: STOP. Do not train a critic on a dataset where the target structure is absent.

GATE_0B_action_conditioned_scorer_validi.fit: Q_psi on one portion of the fresh scorer data
GATE_0B_action_conditioned_scorer_validi.validate_on: held-out scorer episodes/seeds (training-only split, never an evaluation block)
GATE_0B_action_conditioned_scorer_validi.the_real_test: on MATCHED observations, querying both frozen SAPPO teachers on the same o, does the frozen scorer prefer the appropriate teacher's action distribution?
requires: E_{a~pi_A} Q_psi(o, a, A) > E_{a~pi_B} Q_psi(o, a, A)
E_{a~pi_B} Q_psi(o, a, B) > E_{a~pi_A} Q_psi(o, a, B)
GATE_0B_action_conditioned_scorer_validi.calibration_requirement: must hold PER policy/pole cell, not merely in aggregate. A scorer with good overall winner prediction that collapses the specific SAPPO ordering is useless for SPPPO.
GATE_0B_action_conditioned_scorer_validi.if_fails: STOP. SPPPO is not built. The ranking gradient would be decorative.

if_both_gates_pass.then: Phase 1 -- freeze the SPPPO protocol prospectively
SPPPO_holds_fixed: crossover, retention and identity gates UNCHANGED
if_both_gates_pass.only_substantive_new_ingredient: the strategic ranking objective, using the FROZEN Q_psi so the method cannot move the ruler while trying to satisfy it
if_both_gates_pass.CFSD_role: matched-state counterfactual teacher supervision is retained as SUPPORTING supervision, not the causal hypothesis. EXP2C already showed strong policy-level separation does not guarantee crossover.

scientific_hypothesis_under_test: teacher imitation can preserve behavioural identity, but a compressed repertoire additionally requires explicit preservation of the teachers' strategic response ORDERING

evidence_motivating_it.EXP2C: teacher-level behavioural separation (argmax 0.416 vs teachers 0.419), still no payoff specialisation

prohibited: fitting Q_psi on any scored evaluation block
using EXP1/EXP2/EXP2B/EXP2C rows to tune thresholds, select architecture, or choose features
giving the scorer policy identity as an input feature
proceeding to SPPPO if either Phase 0 gate fails
